summary_en: TOMY Company increased interim dividend per share to 40 yen from previously forecast 35 yen, effective December 9, 2026. Year-end dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 was revised to 40 yen per share, bringing total annual dividend to 80 yen from prior forecast of 70 yen.
title_en: Notice on Interim Dividend (Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, TOMY Company's Board of Directors resolved to increase the interim dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend per share for the period ended September 30, 2026 was set at 40 yen, a 5-yen increase from the previous forecast of 35 yen announced on May 12, 2026. The total interim dividend payment amounts to 3,462 million yen, with an effective date of December 9, 2026.

Concurrently, the company revised its year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to 40 yen per share, up from the prior forecast of 35 yen. This brings the total annual dividend for fiscal 2027 to 80 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 70 yen and the prior fiscal year's actual dividend of 64 yen per share.

The dividend increases reflect the company's comprehensive assessment of revised earnings forecasts and financial position announced on October 29, 2026, demonstrating confidence in improved financial performance.
